texts: Sky-cats have always lived on the cliff-spires.
The old Watch ledgers mention sky-cats.

fields.sentence: Sky-cats have always lived on the cliff-spires.

review.notes: Matches the 'Mia has lived in Oslo' pattern (live event, Agent subject, Location oblique, continuative perfect -> Ongoing with no Start since none is stated), and the definite plural 'the cliff-spires' correctly becomes a group witness shared as a constant in the rule conclusion. 'always' here reads as temporal extent rather than quantification over occasions, but the frequency dial (strength 1.0 + QuantifierPhrase companion) is the only licensed carrier and lands on the same value.

fields.sentence: The old Watch ledgers mention sky-cats.

q2_gaps: a capitalized COMMON-noun label in premodifier position ('the old Watch ledgers') -- the Possession licence is stated only for a PROPER noun premodifying a common-noun head, while a capitalized common noun is a common noun by default when it is the referent's own label ('the Assembly'); the instruction set does not say whether such a bare capitalized premodifier mints a referent linked by Possession, or fuses as a compound kind (watch_ledger)
review.notes: Definite plural to a group witness, the descriptive age modifier distributed by the per-member copular rule at 1.0/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase (no quantifier word present), the stative-transitive subject as Agent, and the bare-plural kind-level object as a bare compound symbol with its head genus and unexposed noun modifier -- all as specified. Treating 'mention' as collective (group event, no per-member rule) is a judgment call the instruction set leaves to the distributive-vs-collective test, and the collective reading looks right here.

The capitalized-plural label "the Keepers" is handled exactly as the Name-only individual rule prescribes (no GroupOf, no per-member kind), and the definite named subject keeps this out of the bare-kind relational-generic route. Agent/Theme over Experiencer/Stimulus for "tolerate" is borderline but follows the stated progressive test ("is tolerating" is acceptable).

wild_animal fuses as a classificatory adjective+noun kind and so correctly carries both the head genus and the predicable-modifier genus, while sky_cat exposes its head genus only since 'sky' is a noun modifier. Empirical 0.9/0.9 on the generic is the right side of the definitional/empirical dial for a property an individual could lack.
